title: Report declared Cell membership
summary: Report product identity, Semantics participation, and Chancery presence from repository declarations, or fail a CI check for missing, invalid, or unassessable introductions.
use_when: A caller wants to know which Cell products have declared the essentials for recognition.
CI should require valid identity, Semantics, and Chancery introduction evidence in the candidate checkout.
do_not_use_when: The task requires a Semantics registration, Chancery installation or full bundle validation, or a runtime service probe.
The task concerns relationships beyond Cell membership.
outcome: A deterministic membership report with evidence for all inventoried products or one selected product. The check exit status depends only on required declarations.
effects: Reads the selected checkout inventory, root participation markers, provider manifests, indexed entry identity fields, and indexed manuals.
Prints the report and exits; writes no file, state, registry, or service record and invokes no shell, agent, service, or network.
authority: Cell owns the membership essentials; each product owns its declarations. Usher owns only interpretation of those declarations and the report/check result.
Semantics and Chancery retain their own registration, content, validation, and installed-state authority.
success: All inventoried descriptors remain represented even when introductions are missing or malformed.
A complete product has unambiguous identity and declared Semantics and Chancery findings. Every finding identifies evidence or issues.
Report exits 0 when it can emit findings; check exits 1 for any incomplete selected product. Both exit 2 for command or inventory errors.
failure_and_recovery: Correct the source declarations and rerun. Missing evidence is distinct from invalid evidence and unassessable input.
Unknown schemas, unsupported descriptor syntax, unreadable files, or size limits never become successful declarations.
An absent or empty inventory is a fatal error; an unknown or ambiguous product selection is refused.
privacy: IDs, aliases and relative paths may be sensitive local metadata; report output is caller-owned disclosure. No document body is printed or retained.
does_not_authorize: Registration, deployment, automatic repairs, vocabulary changes, or other product operations.
Using recognition to operate registrations, installations, or runtime services.

consumers.statement: Local contributors and CI may report or require repository-level Cell membership.

preconditions.statement: The caller selects a stable readable Cell checkout with pipeline/products/*.sh descriptors; selection defaults to the current directory.

inputs.statement: A checkout root and optional exact descriptor ID or declared alias. Inputs are schema-one literal descriptors, root AGENTS.md markers, and Chancery provider schemas one through three.

outputs.statement: check uses schema 2. It returns counts and each incomplete identity, Semantics, or Chancery finding, and omits successful evidence. report returns the full product report in schema 1. An incomplete check exits 1. Fatal command or inventory errors exit 2. Both outputs describe repository declarations; they do not test runtime readiness or registration.

data_semantics.statement: Declared means recognized introduction evidence. Missing, invalid, and unassessed remain distinct. Only identity, Semantics participation, and Chancery presence determine membership; all other relationships are outside the report.

identity_and_units.statement: Descriptor filename and PRODUCT_ID identify a product; PRODUCT_DIR identifies its root. Semantic project and provider IDs are separate namespaces and need not equal the product ID. Limits count UTF-8 bytes, descriptors, and indexed entries.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: Every descriptor is examined in filename order, including broken descriptors. Global root, alias, semantic-project, and provider collisions are checked before filtering. The same unchanged inputs and Usher version produce the same report.
Recognition reads product descriptors, Semantics markers, and Chancery introduction files from the selected checkout.

access.statement: Usher reads only local regular UTF-8 evidence under the selected checkout and product/bundle roots. It parses descriptors as data, rejects symbolic evidence and path escapes, and invokes no represented interface.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: One command reads inputs, calculates findings in memory, emits the report, and exits without retained state. Reads are not an atomic filesystem snapshot; the caller keeps source stable and root CI independently rejects source changes.

operational_limits.statement: At most 256 descriptors, 512 indexed entries per provider, and 1 MiB per file. Unsupported shell syntax is never executed. No daemon, database, subprocess, agent, network, service query, or automatic repair exists.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: Usher contract one, JSON schema one, provider schemas one through three, and pipeline schema one are separate. Incompatible recognition or output meaning requires an explicit versioned change.

reliances.statement: The recognition command reads caller-owned repository declarations only. It has no runtime reliance on installed Semantics, Chancery, or any represented system.
